title: Channels
unknown_type: Unknown channel. Open `/channels view` to see the list.
invalid_channel: Pick a text or announcement channel from this server.
set_warning: Channel saved, but I might lack permissions:
private_warn: This channel is private — I'm not on its list.
fix_warn: To fix it: Edit Channel → Permissions → add **{bot}** and allow **{missing}**.
can_post: I can post in this channel.
removed_footer: Use the set command to configure a new one.
already_removed: {label} isn't set, there's nothing to remove.
usage_set: Usage: `.channels set <type> #channel` or `.channels remove <type>`. Types: welcome, goodbye, rules, general, modlog, log, ticket, daily, levelup, updates.
admin_only: You need the Manage Server permission to change channel settings.
heading: Channels of {guild}
hint_welcome: Where ARCHON greets new members with their welcome card.
hint_goodbye: Where ARCHON says goodbye when someone leaves.
hint_rules: Shown to new members on their welcome card. ARCHON only links to it.
hint_general: Where new members are invited to say hi. ARCHON only links to it.
hint_modlog: Bans, kicks, warnings, timeouts and verification results are recorded here.
hint_log: ARCHON's own alerts (a channel it can't post in, a missing permission) and message clean-ups.
hint_ticket: Closed tickets are saved here as a transcript file.
hint_daily: Daily reward reminders and birthday wishes.
hint_levelup: Level-up messages and milestone banners. Without one, ARCHON answers where the member was talking.
hint_updates: ARCHON's release notes, when a new version brings something for your server.
from_discord: Discord's rules channel (set in Server Settings)
why_perms: ARCHON can't post here: it's missing {perms}.
why_timeout: ARCHON is timed out on this server, so it can't post anywhere.
save_failed: That change couldn't be saved. Try again in a moment.
not_yours: Only the person who opened this panel can use it.
expired: This panel is out of date. Run the command again.
